authority: Approved strict stress-neutral 0.2 successor and D67 versioned contract amendment; routine Agent 0 integration decision
decision: Use ops.stress_neutral.v2 and profile_version 0.2.0 for the stock new 0.2 export profile in both desktop and Python. All emitted profile references must name that same profile. Retain the 0.1 profile and producer bytes/behavior.
rationale: The strict successor changes the package/checksum/member contract. Mixed v1 identifiers and inconsistent Python/desktop profile versions make producer identity misleading. A distinct v2 stock profile states the actual contract without modifying history.
constraints: No change to received historical profile metadata or legacy 0.1 producer defaults.
Reference object types and identities must follow the accepted successor schema consistently.

If explicit custom profile metadata is accepted by the new constructor, validate it as a consistent declared successor profile; reject contradictions rather than silently relabeling received or caller-provided claims.
New stock profile, manifest references, validation and checksum/tamper expectations must agree. Any changed derived checksum is recomputed under the new record revision.
Implementation and focused tests remain within the released exact compatibility fence; no new registry or public transport is introduced.
evidence: Final desktop/Python actual emitted packages and independent package validator must agree on the stock successor identity and preserve legacy fixtures.
